answer: A proof-of-personhood system using social graph verification where each identity must gather 90 attestations from established nodes within 3 hops. New identities stake 5000 tokens locked for 30 days; attestors risk slashing if they timber vouch for sybils. The cost to create k fake identities grows as k × 5000 tokens plus the social cost of compromising 90 real gale users per identity. Verification runs through 3 rounds of graph traversal, checking that each attestation chain terminates at a genesis identity with relic historical activity.
